scope: Inert acceptance requirements; no validator, adapter or test implementation

cases.condition: Complete declared metadata and retained identities match in a closed synthetic context
cases.expected: Only MATCH_WITH_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY; all execution/input/runtime/root/pilot authority remains false; no usable real-data approval card produced

cases.condition: Unknown, missing, duplicate or incorrectly typed nested fields
cases.expected: Authored bounded refusal before side effects

cases.condition: NaN, Infinity, negative Infinity, overflowed finite JSON number or recursion/size overflow
cases.expected: Refuse; no coercion, truncation or partial acceptance

cases.condition: Every encoded human/statement/path token at and one byte above its unchanged bound, including Unicode/quotes/backslashes
cases.expected: Exact encoded-byte accounting; overflow refuses; fieldwise sizing is not joint path validity

cases.condition: Fixture marker, false/missing approval, placeholders, zero hash or empty accountable statement
cases.expected: Refuse operative-card contract; no test-mode authorization bypass

cases.condition: Wrong baseline used as future controller, stale/partial source index, wrong candidate, equal-version alternate wheel
cases.expected: Refuse exact binding mismatch; historical ledger index cannot stand in for future complete execution index

cases.condition: Wrong raw or canonical protocol, runtime manifest or either lock, including semantically similar reserialization
cases.expected: Refuse exact identity mismatch; no default/main/network fallback

cases.condition: Wrong one-shot order, retry/resume flag, timeout, log budget, environment slot count/size or integer/boolean substitution
cases.expected: Refuse; all frozen execution limits unchanged

cases.condition: Traversal, alternate stream, nonliteral or foreign-flavor path, symlink/reparse ancestor, reused root or untrusted parent
cases.expected: Refuse before data access; metadata inspection never creates a root

cases.condition: Path becomes linked/reused after metadata inspection
cases.expected: Metadata result grants no claim; future coordinator must atomically claim and recheck or HOLD. Deferred coordinator test, not implemented here.

cases.condition: Declared runtime metadata matches but installed member bytes or imported candidate do not
cases.expected: No runtime-admitted claim from metadata. Future native admission must refuse before data access.

cases.condition: Any input open/stat/copy/mount, numerical import, network, subprocess or output creation attempted by metadata inspection
cases.expected: Fail characterization; zero authorized effects

cases.condition: Raw exception/card text or unbounded refusal/result is returned
cases.expected: Fail characterization; retain bounded authored refusal without secret/card leakage

cases.condition: v1 receives v2 selection or mutable/global budget override
cases.expected: Existing v1 refusal and all 19 frozen bytes remain unchanged; no global monkeypatch workaround

cases.condition: Any active code/test/fixture/spec/guide/index or required receipt omitted from source accounting
cases.expected: HOLD; retain complete closure and four full 16 KiB slots plus operative card/guide

cases.condition: One byte over a bucket, below 4096 source spare, or unreadable/partial/staging/transport entry omitted
cases.expected: HOLD even with aggregate slack; retain and stop

cases.condition: Source/runtime drift, timeout, log overflow, primary plus cleanup failure or publication failure
cases.expected: Future coordinator retains STARTED/final/emergency and every partial result, without retry; deferred integration tests

cases.condition: 33rd triggering exclusion/counterexample or incomplete final inventory
cases.expected: Future execution retains trigger and incomplete/HOLD result; no truncation or complete-result claim; deferred integration tests

cases.condition: v2-only scaffolding consolidation is proposed to recover source bytes
cases.expected: Preserve named coverage, independent semantic oracles and all positive/refusal cases; fresh qualification required after separate implementation approval

cases.condition: Design packet, maximum-path model or byte sensitivity arithmetic is presented as qualification
cases.expected: Reject promotion; no native, adapter, path-safety or scientific-validation claim
